question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

His business was so successful that Mark was able to _______ at the age of 50.
solution:
The correct answer is '**retire**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**retire**" means to leave one's job and stop working, typically upon reaching a certain age or after a successful career.
 
• Mark's successful business allowed him to retire early at the age of 50.
 
• The other options: "**admit**," "**give up**," and "**succeed**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *His business was so successful that Mark was able to retire__ at the age of 50.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Admit (स्वीकार करना)**: means to confess or acknowledge.
 
• **Give up (छोड़ देना)**: means to cease making an effort or to stop doing something.
 
• **Succeed (सफल होना)**: means to achieve a desired result or accomplishment.
